name: Kangoku ~Injoku no Jikkentou~
source:
Yuki Miyagawa usually conducts intelligence activities for government organizations, but this time she is ordered to conduct an internal investigation inside a pharmaceutical company. She needs to find evidence of illegal drugs production. Her identity leaks to the company management, and unimaginable humiliation hell begins for her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
宫川由纪平日为政府机构从事情报活动，这一次却奉命潜入一家制药公司展开内部调查。她需要找到该公司非法生产药物的证据。然而，她的身份泄露给公司管理层，一场难以想象的羞辱地狱就此开始。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
